questions.stem:
Mary has been charged with manslaughter. Mary has told her lawyer that she was acting in self-defence. Her lawyer gives her the following information:

• Self-defence is a partial defence.

• Her case may be heard in a judge-only trial.

Why is some of this information incorrect?

options.A: The trial must be heard before a jury.
options.B: The trial must be heard before a magistrate.
options.C: Self-defence is a complete defence to manslaughter.
options.D: Self-defence cannot be used as a defence to manslaughter.
